emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:e7a4d35f-93b9-44.description: About Alchemy Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Ecosystem Marketing Manager to own and scale Alchemy's presence across the Web3 ecosystem, spanning chain partnerships, infrastructure providers, channel partners, customers, and emerging verticals like traditional finance and agentic commerce. Alchemy is the AWS of blockchain. We power everyone from Azuki and Polymarket to JP Morgan and Robinhood. This role sits at the intersection of all of those relationships and has the unique mandate to build deep, strategic connections across the entire ecosystem, then turn those relationships into high impact co-marketing programs, joint campaigns, thought leadership, and distribution at scale. This role has extraordinary breadth. You'll develop and execute strategy across Web3 native partners (chains, protocols, infrastructure providers), traditional finance institutions entering onchain (JP Morgan, Visa, MasterCard), customers, and channel partners (AWS and beyond). You'll also keep a pulse on the frontiers of blockchain, including stablecoins, RWA tokenization, deposit tokens, institutional staking, and agentic commerce, positioning Alchemy as the infrastructure layer that makes it all possible. This is a senior, strategic role. We're looking for someone who already has existing relationships across the ecosystem and a proven track record of expanding their network, developing a distribution strategy, and executing it at scale. You won't be building a network from scratch. You'll be activating one. flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: COMPANY DESCRIPTION Abiologics, Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company on a mission to make biology better through an innovative therapeutic modality. We are pioneering the development of Synteins™, a transformational class of macromolecular medicines unlocked by novel synthetic and computational technologies. Abiologics is actively seeking exceptional scientists who are passionate about driving therapeutic modality innovation in biotechnology. Abiologics was founded in Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, where companies such as Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ: MRNA) and Generate Biomedicines were conceived and created. Since Flagship’s founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures resulting in more than 500 issued patents and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents. THE ROLE Our Lab Operations Specialist, Chemistry position plays a central role at the interface of multiple disciplines in our Synteins™ discovery effort. The successful candidate will enable operational excellence of laboratory workflows across chemistry, biology, and automation. Your work will directly accelerate the pace at which new therapeutic candidates move from concept to experiment. This role offers opportunities to shape laboratory infrastructure, improve operational workflows, and grow alongside an emerging biotechnology company as our scientific organization expands. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing laboratory inventories, coordinating logistics, and maintaining laboratory instrumentation in a fast-paced research environment. KEY RESPONISIBLITIES Laboratory Operations Collaborate daily with chemists, biologists, protein engineers, automation scientists, and computational researchers, becoming a trusted partner who enables high-quality science across the organization. Partner with researchers and vendors to maximize laboratory uptime and ensure critical discovery platforms remain available. Strategically plan for instrument maintenance, upgrades, and repairs (HPLC-MS, High-resolution mass spectrometers, peptide synthesizers, biolayer interferometry, etc.) Oversee waste disposal and ensure compliance with laboratory safety and environmental regulations. Identify opportunities to streamline laboratory workflows through process improvements, automation, and adoption of new laboratory technologies. Inventory Management Build and continuously improve the systems that enable scientists to rapidly access compounds, reagents, and research materials. Develop and oversee efficient systems for managing compounds and research samples throughout their lifecycle. Maintain accurate digital records that support sample traceability and research reproducibility Perform periodic inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS BS or MS degree or equivalent experience in chemistry, chemical engineering, or biochemistry and 4+ years of experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or academic research laboratory. Experience with laboratory instrumentation maintenance and general laboratory operations. Experience managing laboratory inventory systems and compound/sample management. Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and laboratory information management or inventory systems. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. rws-rws:lever:e38cfad1-6c40-47da-b9b4-e8.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: India (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 6 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in India. Native-level written and spoken fluency in Tamil. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.
